acts.label: Prologue

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Lina Misitzis travels to Greece with her family to exhume the bones of her dead grandmother.
acts.title: Family Plot

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: After his mother passes, a man unearths her book collection… and is surprised. (6 1/2 minutes)
acts.title: Next of Kindle

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: David Kestenbaum tells the story of a man on the verge of one of the greatest scientific discoveries of all time … right on the verge.
acts.title: A Curious Bone

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: In her forties, Jill Ciment wrote about the love of her life. Twenty years later, she’s writing something new about the exact same thing.
acts.title: Revision Quest
